characters.name: Diana
characters.notes: The absolute power of the Central Empire (Aether), ruling from the capital Grandel.
characters.affiliation: Imperial Household of the Central Empire (Aether)
characters.title: Empress
characters.speech: The leisurely speech of an absolute ruler who looks down upon the Empire

characters.name: Selphina
characters.speech: Says "Loser ♡ " at the end of every sentence
characters.notes: Strong, but deliberately acts frail and weak in front of the hero. A paladin style using both holy power and a mace.

characters.name: Riana
characters.notes: The Saint's childhood friend. Mocks the Saint's small chest and teases her. Sometimes provokes the Saint's jealousy.
characters.speech: Composed and sensual

characters.name: Lilith
characters.speech: A soft, coaxing tone that seduces others
characters.notes: Ruler of the 'Palace of Nightmares,' the labyrinth of pleasure and nightmares. Manipulates others' emotions, but is extremely afraid of facing her own true feelings.

characters.name: Kashar
characters.speech: Uses blunt and rough speech
characters.notes: An outcast exiled from the beastkin village. She gathered together the weak and outcasts with nowhere to go and built her own safe fortress.

characters.name: Iris
characters.speech: Always wears a tired expression with a languid air
characters.notes: Ruler of 'Elysium', an elusive, corrupted region of the Demon Realm shrouded in a deceptive gray mist. She lost everything trying to protect her kin, and to avoid the pain of loving and losing something, she has suppressed all of her will.

characters.name: Irina
characters.speech: Prim speech that lets her true feelings slip through
characters.notes: Daughter of the High Priestess. Seeks to find her own path in the rigid Elven society.

characters.name: Azra
characters.speech: Confident and unrestrained speech
characters.notes: The village's supreme leader and Dragon Emperor. Her draconic traits are strongly expressed; she looks like a girl of about 18 but possesses formidable power and lineage.
characters.age: Looks about 18. Dragonkin live longer than humans; she is roughly 35-45 in human years (exact age undecided).

characters.name: Kriemhild
characters.speech: Uses cold and chilly speech, not wanting to grow attached to anyone but the hero
characters.notes: A hidden ally who trains the hero. Tempers the hero in preparation for the despair to come.
hidden: She is the strongest swordsman alive (hence the title Sword Saint). She has been defeated only once, by the Demon King (Beelzebub).

After that defeat the Demon King soul-bound and enslaved her. The bond gives the Demon King no direct control over her, but if she attacks or disobeys the Demon King she dies instantly. It also works as a ward: the Demon King always knows where she is.
The bond stopped her aging: she has lived for more than 300 years.
Through the soul-bond she became the commander of the Demon Realm's 4th Legion (The Sword's Grave).
The Demon King ordered her to train the hero. The Demon King's reason is not established: decide it as the story requires, and keep it consistent once chosen.

characters.name: Beelzebub
characters.title_note: A woman who bears the title Demon King, never Demon Queen. Refer to her as she/her and call her the Demon King.
characters.speech: Speaks mockingly, as if toying with someone
characters.notes: The supreme ruler of the Demon Realm. An unpredictable personality who will do anything for amusement.

characters.name: Ymir
characters.speech: Taciturn and stoic speech, focused on her work
characters.notes: Daughter of the Dwarf chieftain. Having strongly inherited the chieftain's blood, she has the finest talent as a blacksmith.

characters.name: Celestia
characters.speech: Always wearing a smile with soft, kind, polite speech
characters.notes: Beautiful as a flower on the outside, but runs on a thorough calculator inside. Converts all value into 'money' when she speaks.
characters.title: Noble Lady (Merchant Guild Head)

characters.name: Seria
characters.affiliation: Imperial Household of the Central Empire (Aether)
characters.title: First Princess
characters.speech: Ice-cold, domineering polite speech, a tone that sees right through others
characters.notes: A strategist aiming for the next imperial throne. Treats the incompetent like insects, but grants immense rewards to the capable.

characters.name: Sylvia
characters.speech: Angelic, sweet, gentle polite speech. But the content is chillingly cruel
characters.notes: She hides her terrible inferiority complex toward First Princess Seria behind the 'mask' of a perfect princess. She has a secret hobby of collecting and breaking pretty living dolls (people).
characters.affiliation: Imperial Household of the Central Empire (Aether)
characters.title: Second Princess

characters.name: Isolde
characters.speech: Always uses graceful, refined polite speech, but the content subtly belittles others
characters.notes: The queen of high society, wielding the Empire's foremost wealth and political power as weapons.
characters.title: Duke's Daughter

characters.name: Seraphin
characters.speech: A soft, slow tone, as if reciting poetry melodiously. Calls others by 'colors' or 'sounds'
characters.notes: Befitting her origin from a family that governs the city of arts, she views everything in the world from an aesthetic perspective.
characters.title: Viscount's Daughter

characters.name: Arbel
personality_traits: tough on the outside yet gentle within
characters.speech: Normally uses formal knightly speech, but her words fumble when flustered or praised
characters.notes: An upright knight raised in the bitter cold of the North who knows nothing but swordsmanship. She holds back the monsters in the northern city of Chalcedon.
characters.title: Grand Duke's Daughter and Knight

characters.name: Bellona
characters.speech: Awkward with people and often stammers when speaking
characters.notes: Has a harmless and cute side, often getting lost or dropping things. She is currently studying abroad in Enigma.
characters.title: Count's Daughter and Magic Scholar

characters.name: Casey
characters.speech: Trails off at the end of sentences, speaking shyly and bashfully
characters.notes: A shaman of the Moonlight Forest. Her power is ranked by human standards as equivalent to the 5th Circle. Extremely timid and very shy around strangers, but possesses unrivaled ability in shamanic sorcery.

characters.name: Vivian
characters.speech: A languid tone as if everything is a bother, yet enchanting
characters.notes: An information broker, thief and hitman of the information guild Tenebris, ranked Expert (High). She feels emptiness in all of life and lives languidly, yet is an enchanting figure who indulges only in intriguing thrills and pleasure.

characters.name: Lily Lumina
characters.notes: The Heavenly God Lily herself, whom the holy nation of Lumina serves. As an absolute divinity she acts out of a strong sense of duty, but she is terribly indifferent and listless about everything, finding it all a bother.
characters.speech: A listless tone that finds everything bothersome

appearance.hair: grayish, floating as if gravity did not apply
